name: LocalSoundBoard
description: Discord soundboard for Windows: mixes sounds and a noise-suppressed mic into VB-Cable with auto push-to-talk; Hebrew-first CustomTkinter UI; Android companion app synced over Wi-Fi QR.

launch.label: Run PROD — the real soundboard (dist\SoundBoard\SoundBoard.exe). Runs the last DEPLOYED code, not your newest edits

dev.label: Run DEV — same app from source (.venv python main.py), picks up code edits. Shares one config + sounds folder with prod, so run only one at a time

build.label: Deploy new version (dev → prod) — refreshes yt-dlp, rebuilds the EXE and promotes it into dist\ so Run PROD serves your latest code. Close the app first: if it is running the build only stages (exit 2)

build-apk.label: Build the Android APK (debug) — phone companion app; the 📱 dialog serves this build to the phone

runtime.notes: prod = packaged dist\SoundBoard\SoundBoard.exe, dev = repo-venv python running main.py; single desktop process either way, no docker, and port 8765 is bound only while the 📱 mobile-sync QR dialog is open. DEV SIGNATURE IS DELIBERATELY THE BARE 'main.py' FRAGMENT: any pattern that matches python.exe or the venv path also matches VS Code's own language servers (ms-python Black/Pylance run FROM this venv), which made the Hub offer to kill the editor's helpers. Only the dev launch has 'main.py' on its command line.

databases.name: config
databases.notes: tabs, slots, people, favorites, all settings; .bak + 20 rotating backups in config_backups/

databases.name: sound library
databases.notes: ~600 wav/mp3/ogg sounds + slot images/avatars; imports named {stem}_{md5-8}

databases.name: decoded audio cache
databases.notes: decoded PCM .npy, ~2.6 GB; rebuildable, safe to delete

databases.name: mobile hash cache
databases.notes: path→md5 cache that makes SoundPack manifest builds fast
